policy: For qualified embedded Type0 custom Encoding CMap streams, copy the original SFNT head global rendering bounds bytes36..43 after validating finite signed-int16 ordered bounds enclosing every retained simple/composite glyph. Preserve old tight-derived header behavior for Identity-H and simple TrueType profiles.
header_change_scope: Only head global rendering bbox8bytes and mandatory font/table checksum adjustments differ from the old custom-CMap rebuild policy; other builder header fields, glyf outlines/flags/metrics, GIDclosure, maxp, CVT/program rewrite and resource metadata retain their existing validated behavior.
not_approved: No unused/removed glyph data retention; no Unicode from GID; no general font, CFF/variable-font or raster qualification; original direct PDFium collapse failures remain FAIL.
profiles_propagated: per font resource, shared pages, sibling Form, annotation appearance N/R/D; positive fully-contained space condition uses the same original custom-CMap rendering bounds

prior_source_policy_generation_attempt.error: KeyError on unused page/1 font binding before write
prior_source_policy_generation_attempt.correction: iterate fixed actual source uses; unused source resources still inspected independently and may not survive unbound in output
